description: 1,000-file batch resilience run (blueprint section 10): an as-shot JPEG batch of every fixture, real copies of small fixtures, truncated copies and synthetic DNGs, with two injected worker crashes, a pause and resume, Lucent.exe ended mid-batch and started again (--resume-batch), then a separate batch cancelled after a few photos; every output hashed by a watcher and checked against the report.

session1.rule: from the first finished photo: last-tenth median of Lucent.exe commit <= first-tenth median + 64 MiB, and the workers together <= the aggregate limit

session2.rule: from the first finished photo: last-tenth median of Lucent.exe commit <= first-tenth median + 64 MiB, and the workers together <= the aggregate limit
